recipe.criteria: Unilateral calf press on a 45-degree leg press. Left knee fixed at 165 degrees, ankle plantarflexes over 4 seconds and returns over 4 seconds. Left forefoot only on the plate; right leg bent with foot on separate fixed support. Hands retain handles, pelvis and back fixed.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
